name: Scott Mann
bio: Scott Mann (born 1979) is a British filmmaker. He is the creator of the Fall franchise. He is best known for directing the films The Tournament (2009), Heist (2015), Final Score (2018) and Fall (2022).

credits.title: The Tournament
credits.overview: Every seven  years, in an unsuspecting town, The Tournament takes place. A battle royale between 30 of the world's deadliest assassins. The last man standing receives the $10,000,000 cash prize and the title of World's No. 1 Assassin, which itself carries the legendary million dollar-a-bullet price tag.

credits.title: Tug of War
credits.overview: Tug of War is a naughty, fun film - in the great British Carry On tradition of cheeky film-making. Four college friends enter into a bet to see who can go the longest without 'self-love.' Tug of War follows their trials and tribulations as they try to last ten torturous days.
